precepts.text: Purge out the old leaven that ye may be a new lump, for Christ our passover is sacrificed for us. To be a faithful steward you have to purge the old leaven out of yourself.
precepts.point: Let a man account of us as ministers of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God. It is required in stewards that a man be found faithful.

note.label: Much Is Given, Much Is Required

precepts.why:
“Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God. Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.” In a steward you have to be found faithful. How?

“Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us”. If you want to be a minister of God, you have to purge out the old leaven. You cannot be moving with old leaven inside of you. Christ died for our sin, so we have to purge it out.

Paul says the same to the Corinthians again: “Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you, And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters”. Then: “Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.” Cleanse yourself and you are new: “if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.”

That is the faithful steward: a man who has purged the old leaven out of himself, so that he does not live in hypocrisy, teaching the people to come out of the world while he himself does not live it.

precepts.text: God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death, a spectacle unto the world. That is the cost. Do you want to die as an apostle found faithful, or run the whole race and hear him say I never knew you?
precepts.point: Let a man account of us as ministers of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God. It is required in stewards that a man be found faithful.

note.label: Much Is Given, Much Is Required

precepts.why:
“For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, and to angels, and to men.” This is the cost to pay: we are going to be a spectacle, and we are appointed unto death.

So do you want to die as an apostle with the old leaven still living in you, or do you want to die as an apostle found faithful? Otherwise you say, Lord, Lord, did I not prophesy in your name, and he says, I don't know you. Then why are you doing this? To run this whole race and not get it?

Much is given, much is required. The Lord gave you understanding and shared it with you; where is the return? Are you playing games, treating this Bible like a joke? He will say, I gave you a lot of understanding, now I will punish you accordingly because you knew better: you were profitable to many, but not profitable to yourself.

We persuade men because we know the terror of the Lord, and we cleanse ourselves in the fear of God. That is why the steward must be found faithful: we are appointed to death as a spectacle to the world, and only the faithful steward receives the promise.

precepts.text: Judge nothing before the time, until the Most High brings to light the hidden things and makes manifest the counsels of the hearts.
precepts.point: This is the true meaning of loving your enemies. Christianity twists it to mean love the ones who enslaved, raped, and colonized your ancestors, stole your nationality, land, and heritage, miseducated you, gave you a false image of God, and today shut down anyone who says Israel is the true children of God. That is not the enemy the scripture means. The Bible means love the enemies within your own nation, because Paul, who persecuted and killed the disciples, was one of those enemies who could still repent.
precepts.why:
Ananias had heard by many how much evil Saul had done to the saints at Jerusalem. Saul had consented to Stephen's death and chased the disciples from city to city with zeal. Was he doing it in ignorance? Yes. That is why the scripture says, “judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts”.

The things we all did in the world were worthy of death, so who are we to say a man is beyond repentance? The killer, even a pastor putting us to death in the future, may come to the truth later and say he did it in ignorance, as Christ and Stephen both prayed, Father, forgive them. Even a sister who cursed the teacher out on the streets for months came around and began to listen, because anyone can repent. Leave the judging to the Most High, who will make manifest the counsels of the hearts.

note.label: Sabbath Morning Class: Messengers Of The Nation

precepts.why: “For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, and to angels, and to men.” God has set forth us the apostles last. You saved the best for last: we have been appointed to bring his truth out last. All these movements have come and gone; this last one is God’s movement.

note.label: Sabbath Morning Class: Messengers Of The Nation

precepts.why: Hitting the same scriptures, going in a circle: “I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last”. The apostles were the last, and God set them forth to bring his truth out. Matthew 20:16, Luke 9:22, Matthew 23:1 and 1 Corinthians 4:9 are the foundation: the scribes, chief priests and elders that sat in Moses’ seat were first, and the apostles set forth last.

“For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last”. After all those leaders rose up and had their chance, God sends the apostles last.

“As it were appointed to death”: it is appointed for these men to die, because all revolutionaries die. A revolutionary makes up his mind to be a martyr and die for his people.

This is where Paul said we are fools for Christ. “We are fools for Christ’s sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye are honourable, but we are despised.” We are fools for Christ’s sake: the wayfaring men on that highway are these fools for Christ.
“These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth.” “Wherefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me.”

note.label: Lamentations And The Fall Of Teman

precepts.why: “Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people”: that’s what Paul said. “Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.” Being defamed as the Israelites. The Israelites are made as the filth of the world, the offscouring, like dung, the doodoo of the earth, of all things unto this day. It was true back then and it’s true today.

note.label: Must Be Hated To Be Heard! The Price Of Speaking Truth To Modern Day Christians

precepts.why:
“For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, and to angels, and to men.” Appointed to death. Look at these Power Rangers walking the streets in order, they say; they think we are clowns, not knowing they are witnessing the sons of God back on the earth.

“We are fools for Christ’s sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong.” The people will be made wise and strong in Christ by what we teach. “Ye are honourable, but we are despised.”

“Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwellingplace.” These men were ostracized and called fools for teaching this word, lost everything and had no certain dwelling place. “And labour, working with our own hands: being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it.” We hold jobs; we are not sitting here collecting tithes to pay our bills. Their pastors are not on the front line; the only time they come out is to collect money or for a photo op. And people ask why we march instead of helping in Chicago; we have already been there.

“Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.” We have been called sellouts, witches, pedophiles, wife abusers, gay; we are looked at as the filth of the world.

“I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.” Prepare your soul for temptation and tribulation; this is what you signed up for. “For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.” Paul was beaten and imprisoned, and says follow the example I set; he asked nothing he had not gone through. We ask the men to go out there, and there is nothing we are not doing or have not done. In Orlando, years ago, there was nowhere to stand, no foot traffic and no reader but a six-year-old son; the word was taught to the buses, the bus stop and the parking lots. The word does not go out void: today Orlando, Miami, Tallahassee, Jacksonville and Tampa are full of Israelites.

note.label: From Negroes to Gods from Earth to Gold

points: Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God. That is who we are. We are declaring the mysteries of God. We are the stewards.

Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful. But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man's judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self. For I know nothing by myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judgeth me is the Lord.

Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts. Because some of you all are hiding stuff. But it says the Lord will make known the hidden things of the heart. And then shall every man have praise of God.

You ever see some of the camps, you see the same teacher all the time? That is not with us. Any state you go to, whoever is over that state, those men are known. There is one camp where all you see is this one person from the camp. He is all over social media. You do not even see the leader the way you see him. You do not see no other teacher. That whole camp is weak, because you only let one man speak. Paul was against that. Everybody should be nice with the scriptures, no matter what state we go to. You should not just keep seeing one person from the organisation doing every single debate. We know if someone asks for a debate in Michigan and California and Washington, we have got men there.

And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written. Because some people take these secrets and the understanding that they have, and they think they are better than each other. We are not supposed to do that. Even though the ministries are against us, we still want to sit down with them and teach them. They have the arrogance, like we are beneath them to speak to them. So like I will be saying in the clubhouse, if you all come humble and you all come to learn, I am going to match your energy. But if you all come with arrogance and you all are trying to set us up or try to make us look stupid, you are going to get that work.

That no one of you be puffed up for one against another. Because they knew a lot. So it is easy to look at a man, because he knows the mysteries, he knows the secrets, and think they are so great. We have got to be humble with each other. You see how we are eager? We call you guys, come. We want to tell you what we know, because we want you guys to grow.

For who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it? Now ye are full, now ye are rich, ye have reigned as kings without us: and I would to God ye did reign, that we also might reign with you. Because when you do good, we do good. And that is what Paul was saying. Even though we are stewards of God and these mysteries, these secrets, have been given to each other, we are all on the same level. If I do not know something, I am going to tell you.

But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man's judgment. The Corinthians ran their mouths about Paul behind his back, because Paul had a past: he hunted the believers down. But the Lord called him out of that, and Paul said, I do not care what you think of me.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

points: Yea, I judge not mine own self; he that judgeth me is the Lord. Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of God.
Judge nothing, and no one, before the time; because what happened to somebody yesterday can happen to you today.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

points: God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world. That is what the hiders do not want: they want to be Israelites in the background. No; if you are in this truth, you are a light that shines on a mountaintop. You cannot blend in. That is why they want the camps gone, because the camps put this truth in the forefront. You are going to die in the background too.

note.label: Traitors and Their Exquisite Subtlety: The Judas Iscariot Effect

Reviled means slandered and lied on; defamed is being labeled hateful and phobic. We are made as the filth of the world, the offscouring of all things unto this day. Rejected, but the Lord does not reject us; the Lord has our back.

note.label: Traitors and Their Exquisite Subtlety: The Judas Iscariot Effect

points: God hath set forth us the apostles last. Before us came Pedro Albizu Campos, Blanca Canales, Lolita Lebron, Filiberto Ojeda Rios, the Young Lords, all the brothers and sisters who paved the way and fought for our rights. It was not just the southern kingdom fighting in the 60s; the northern kingdom was fighting as well.

Albizu Campos passed away April 21st, 1965, and four days later there was a revolution in the Dominican Republic the same year. There were always revolts in Cuba, in Haiti, in the Dominican Republic, in Puerto Rico, because we are not a people that is supposed to be enslaved or indoctrinated.

The Most High left the apostles last, as it is to this day. People are going to laugh at the men in purple and gold, but the scriptures prove who we are. God left the truth so that we can find it and plant it in the hearts and minds of our people. We have a big job to do.

note.label: Much Is Given, Much Is Required

points: God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death. The Nation of Islam, Marcus Garvey, Martin Luther King, the Black Panthers, the Young Lords and AIM all rose up under oppression, and our people are in the same condition. God left the apostles for last: the 144,000, planting the seed of God in the hearts of our people.
Appointed to death: the apostles are here in the last days and will die doing this work, as Garvey and Malcolm X were killed.
God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death, for we are made a spectacle unto the world.
We are made a spectacle: you fools. Damn, we just stoned you the other day; why are you back here?

We are fools for Christ's sake, but ye are wise in Christ: talking about those in the world, those leaders. Ye are honourable, but we are despised. You can relate that: you've got Christianity and you've got the prophets. Christianity, they're raised up, they're honourable, they're strong. We're looked at as weak, as despised.

Being persecuted, we suffer it. This is like Christ: he marvelled at their unbelief, but it did not stop the teaching. Even though we're persecuted, even though we're called a hate group, called purple power rangers, that don't stop us from hitting the streets and going to the same people, trying to save lives.

We are made as the filth of the world: here we are, people coming from all walks of life, cleaning themselves up, honouring marriage, honouring fatherhood, and then all of a sudden we're the filth of the world. We're a damn hate group. We're the extremists. Same thing our forefathers were dealing with, we're dealing with.
I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you: we're warning you about that familiarity. It has always brought forth death. Death by familiarity.

For though ye have ten thousand instructers in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: so the Bible says, though you have 10,000 instructors in Christ. Go on YouTube right now. You going to see thousands of instructors. You going to see hundreds of videos of young brothers rising up teaching that they Israel, but they have not many fathers. They don't have leadership. They don't have people to guide them, to show them, hey brother, why you debating that guy? The Bible said, Cast not your pearls before swine. And you ain't never read that the Bible say Esau going into captivity? Revelation 13:9 and 10 says, He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity. Why would you argue with a slave? Why would you argue with a future slave? Does that make sense? When we was in captivity, the white man wasn't arguing with us in the cotton field. He was shooting … dead. The Bible tells you very clearly, you have many instructors, but not many fathers. And thank God I got spiritual fathers.

Have you heard of any Christians being persecuted? Nobody says they can’t celebrate Christmas. If they teach the truth, why is nobody mad about it? “Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwellingplace”.

“Being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.” To this day we are the offscouring of all things.

“I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.” Paul warned us of these things that are going to come in these last days. There is no need to worry, no need to cry; in fact you should laugh. Esau says, you’re done. All right, cool, all praises, on to the next one, because we know what’s coming.

“Being defamed”: in this truth, brothers and sisters, we are being defamed by all the nations. That’s why that fake Rabbi said there’s a problem with the black Americans, they’re the problem, they’re extremists, they hate everybody, they want to harm people. All lies and slander. So it is true: we will be defamed, and we are being defamed.

“We are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.” Everybody is going to turn against this truth as they hear it. Now don’t misunderstand: a large remnant of our people is prophesied to repent, one-third, and one-third is millions. That’s why you can’t worry about it.

“I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.” Paul said, I’m warning you, and that’s what we’re doing today. Some of you still got one foot in Christianity; you’re about to celebrate Thanksgiving next week and make up a lie while you’re celebrating it. So we are warning you what is coming.

The society we live in shows how destroyed we are as a people: a wife who passed off twins as her husband's for twelve years, a woman with seven children by seven men, a mother who left her young daughters alone for days to fly to Miami. Some of us are stupid, black people are stupid; not all black people, but some of us. And some of you will lose the kingdom for a woman like that. We are destroyed as a people, a broken people; some of us are at the point of no return. And who is going to fix it? The white man and the other nations love stuff like that. T.D. Jakes cannot change it, Creflo Dollar cannot change it. We, the men, are the last hope of our people. But you cannot fix this if your mind is on coochie all the time.

“For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last”: that is us, brothers. “As it were appointed to death”: by taking this charge, this job, we are going to die for it, and we have to prepare ourselves to die for it. A real prophet, a real leader, does not choose his destiny; his destiny was picked for him before he was even born. Some of us are destined to die for this, some to be tortured, some to go to jail. This is going to get done with you or without you; you have to choose a side.

“For we are made a spectacle unto the world”: we are the most hated people on the planet Earth, especially the Israelite. Even our own people hate us: your wife, your children, your father, your mother hate your guts. So what have you got to lose? You are already hated. Take up your cross and walk. You have to make up your own mind what you want to do.

She hates her children, she hates her own people, she hates herself, and in her mind she does nothing wrong: no remorse, zero accountability. Those are the women some want to lose the kingdom for. Only the Bible can change a mindset like that. So there is no time to play games: you are either all in, or you are out; you cannot have one foot in and one foot out.
